package.title: UX: Mobile & Responsive Modernization
package.summary: The site targets mobile users in its marketing copy ("150 times a day" phone-checks) but ships Bootstrap 3 navbar + img-responsive classes (BS3 was EOL July 2019), no srcset/sizes for the hero banner, no apple-touch-icon, no theme-color, no PWA manifest, and a carousel that ignores prefers-reduced-motion. On modern phones the site looks dated and cannot be installed as an app.

findings.title: Bootstrap 3 navbar markup (navbar-toggle, icon-bar) - BS3 EOL July 2019
Images use img-responsive (Bootstrap 3 class, removed in BS4/5)
Hero banner loads full-size PNG with no srcset/sizes
No apple-touch-icon, no theme-color, no PWA manifest
Colorbox lightbox has no touch/swipe support - mobile users cannot navigate
Copyright year hardcoded as '© 2014 - Vivim' - never updates
viewport meta lacks viewport-fit=cover for notch/Dynamic Island
